projects.ai_summary: Apache Maka 是一个本地优先的 AI 代理工作区，用于记录和管理 AI 代理的交互数据。采用 TypeScript 开发，通过仅追加日志的方式记录模型消息、工具调用、结果、权限决策和终止事件。

projects.name: awesome-gpt-image-2
projects.description: Prompt as Code | GPT-Image2 工业级提示词引擎与模板库，530+ 个案例逆向工程，20+ 套工业级模板，并提炼出Skills，持续更新中
projects.ai_summary: 提供工业级GPT图像生成提示词引擎与模板库，包含530+逆向工程案例和20+工业级模板。基于JavaScript实现，通过模块化Skills设计提升提示词复用性和生成质量。

projects.name: ai-job-search
projects.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
projects.ai_summary: 本地化AI求职框架，支持职位评估、简历定制、求职信撰写和面试准备。采用Python构建，基于Claude模型实现自动化求职流程。

projects.name: codex
projects.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
projects.ai_summary: 轻量级终端代码生成工具，支持开发者快速编写代码片段。使用Rust实现，通过命令行交互提供低延迟的编码辅助。

projects.name: ponytail
projects.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
projects.ai_summary: Ponytail 是一个 AI 代理工具，旨在通过最小化代码编写量来提升开发效率。它采用 JavaScript 实现，模拟资深开发者思维，推崇‘不写代码就是最好的代码’理念。

projects.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
projects.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
projects.ai_summary: 该项目通过单个 CLAUDE.md 文件优化 Claude 代码生成行为，解决大语言模型编码常见缺陷。基于 Andrej Karpathy 对 LLM 编码问题的观察提炼而成。

projects.name: claude-obsidian
projects.description: Self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + Claude Code. Drop any source and Claude reads, links, and files it into one connected knowledge graph of plain Markdown you own. AI note-taking, personal knowledge management (PKM), and an open-source Notion alternative. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.
projects.ai_summary: 为 Obsidian 和 Claude 构建自组织的 AI 第二大脑系统，实现知识图的自动化管理。采用 Python 开发，基于 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式，以纯 Markdown 构建可自主管理的知识库。

projects.name: ai-engineering-from-scratch
projects.description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
projects.ai_summary: 该项目是一个AI工程实践教程，帮助用户从零开始学习、构建并部署AI应用。采用Python实现，涵盖从基础到实战的全流程开发。

projects.name: openhuman
projects.description: Your Personal AI super intelligence. A brain that builds a local-first memory of your life, a fantastic orchestrator of agent fleets and workflows, and a deep researcher.

projects.description: Community plugin marketplace for Claude Cowork and Claude Code. Read-only mirror — submit plugins at clau.de/plugin-directory-submission.
